decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric sits close to the firm's core knowledge, but it was moved from its own page to a mere mention in 2024, so attention is fading; since the firm can still interpret and adapt it cheaply, it stays in the collection for now.

The semi-transparent bouclé-effect decorative fabric builds directly on the firm's design competence and has held a stable mention on the website, so the firm understands its market well and can keep it at low cost.

The flame-retardant jacquard fits the firm's functional contract-textile knowledge and kept its own page in both years, which signals a strategic product the firm can develop further through its own R&D.

The double-face wool blend builds on the firm's established competence and its renewable materials fit the sustainability direction, though its modest visibility leaves some risk of a collection rotation.
The wool bouclé leno combines familiar techniques with renewable wool in line with the sustainability strategy, and its stable mention suggests it is an ongoing collection item.

The braided-structure fabric is newly launched with its own page and extends the firm's know-how across upholstery and curtains, so it is too early to judge the results and the firm is actively learning from it.
